about_the_game:
Adventure Mansion is a multiplayer adventure game built around scavenger hunts, riddles, and choice. Players explore a sprawling mansion under the direction of a commanding and enigmatic Host, whose instructions arrive as spoken clues, riddles, and challenges that shape the course of each session.

Each play session unfolds as a sequence of distinct adventures. Players are given a starting point, not a solution. Some paths move the group forward. Others lead somewhere unexpected. When players falter, the Host does not simply dismiss them — the role they play may change.

Example host scavenger clue:

As any true ascent begins,
climb toward grandeur and leave the ground behind.
Favor the path that feels right—
the number of fingers on thy hand shall point the way.

Then seek thy chamber where thy doppelgänger waits,
where porcelain meets wood and clawed feet rest.
With a lingering flick, crimson glows unabated.

When thou art ready,
face thine other self.

The name reveals itself only in the mist.
Invoke it thrice. Adventure awaits.

The Host awaits eager to instruct.  Do you answer the call?

**Warning:** This game contains flashing lights and intense visual effects that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Please play with caution.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Adventure Mansion is a multiplayer scavenger-hunt game led by an enigmatic Host, where exploration comes first, mystery follows, and tension builds along the way.
